description: Draws freehand pen strokes from SVG path data (curves and arcs are flattened into pen lines; fills are ignored, so describe outlines). The drawing is scaled uniformly so it is `width` board units wide (default 400) with its top-left corner at x, y; its height follows from its shape. Think of the path coordinates as any convenient SVG coordinate system. Coordinates are board units (about one screen pixel at 100% zoom); x grows right and y grows DOWN, the origin is arbitrary and boards are unbounded. Read the board first and place new content next to the current content bounds rather than on top of it. Changes appear live for everyone who has the board open.

boardId.description: Board id (a UUID) from board_list or board_create.

d.description: SVG path data (M L H V C S Q T A Z, absolute or relative). Fills are ignored: every path is drawn as a pen line.

width.description: Pen width in board units, default 3.
Overall drawing width in board units, default 400.

y.description: Top edge, board units (y grows downwards). Default 0.

name: board_draw
title: Draw freehand on a Todrawn board
